tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text search over TridentStack Control's customer documentation (guides, API reference, changelog, roadmap). Returns ranked results with titles, URLs, and snippets. tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Return the full markdown of a single documentation chunk by its id (from a search_docs result). Only ids present in the index are valid; this never fetches arbitrary URLs.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List the documentation catalog (id, title, source, url), optionally filtered to one content type. Use to browse structure before searching.
